steps.label: Fetch the latest published blog post
Draft a social thread from the post
steps.spawnPrompt: Read the blog post in {{latest_post.body}} and draft an 8-tweet thread: hook first, one idea per tweet, CTA last. Match the company voice: direct, no hashtags, no emoji.

steps.label: Draft a newsletter section from the post
steps.spawnPrompt: Summarize the blog post in {{latest_post.body}} into a 150-word newsletter section with a one-line takeaway and a read-more link.

steps.label: Editorial review before anything is queued
steps.gateMessage: Review the drafted thread and newsletter section. Approving queues both for publishing.

steps.label: Queue the approved thread in Typefully
